The function expects crime as string. We'll use "money laundering". Then second call for 2018, location "Texas".

We should call the function twice. According to guidelines, we can only call one function per turn? Actually we can call multiple times but each call is separate. But we might combine them into two calls. The guidelines say we can call a function multiple times if needed. So we will do two calls.

We need to output the results. The function returns any. We don't know the structure. Probably a list of individuals. We'll just pass the result.

We'll produce a single response with the function calls. The first call: law_crimes_search({"crime":"money laundering","location":"San Francisco","year":2019}). Then second call: law_crimes_search({"crime":"money laundering","location":"Texas","year":2018}).

We need to format the calls correctly. Use the function name and arguments. We'll do:

{
  "name": "law_crimes_search",
